# Ordinary permissive storefront robots.txt (shape taken from a stock Shopify
# template). Nothing here names us, so the '*' group binds and we are allowed.
User-agent: *
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /cart
Disallow: /orders
Disallow: /checkouts/
Disallow: /collections/*sort_by*
Disallow: /*/collections/*sort_by*
Disallow: /collections/*+*
Allow: /products.json
Crawl-delay: 3

Sitemap: https://example-storefront.test/sitemap.xml
